product_one_liner.value: Smallest.ai provides speech-generation, speech-recognition and conversational voice-agent infrastructure for developers and enterprises building real-time voice applications.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes speech models and a hosted voice-agent platform with dashboard and SDK access, while its announcement identifies enterprises as customers. Sources: https://linkedin.com/company/smallest, https://docs.smallest.ai/ and https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/smallestai-gets-21-million-in-funding-to-build-voice-4-0--the-next-generation-of-enterprise-voice-ai-302839266.html.

pricing_page.notes: Public model and voice-agent pricing pages exist: https://smallest.ai/pricing/models and https://smallest.ai/pricing/agents.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Official customer stories describe Pocket using Pulse and Kogta using Smallest AI for collections: https://smallest.ai/pocket and https://smallest.ai/customer-stories/kogta. | named_customers.0: Pocket’s official case study describes its use of Smallest’s Pulse. | named_customers.1: The official Kogta case study describes collections calls using Smallest AI.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 105 employees, which falls in the 101–200 band: https://inc42.com/company/smallest-ai/people. Headcount is a third-party estimate.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company’s LinkedIn profile explicitly identifies San Francisco as its headquarters: https://linkedin.com/company/smallest. | hq_country: The company’s LinkedIn profile identifies its headquarters as San Francisco, California, US: https://linkedin.com/company/smallest.

founded_year.notes: The company’s founder biography explicitly says he started Smallest AI in 2023: https://smallest.ai/author/sudarshan-kamath.

eng_blog.notes: Two substantive technical publications are present: an inference-hardware co-optimization article by a named senior inference engineer, and original SonoEdit model-editing research coauthored by Smallest AI researchers. Sources: https://smallest.ai/blog/rewriting-tts-inference-economics-lightning-v2-on-tenstorrent-achieves-4%C3%97-lower-cost-than-nvidia-l40s, https://smallest.ai/author/ranjith-m-s and https://smallest.ai/research/sonoedit-null-space-constrainedknowledge-editing-forpronunciation-correction-inllm-based-tts. This treats the company’s technical research section as qualifying technical publishing alongside its engineering blog.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation portal exposes voice-agent guides, model documentation and an API reference with code examples: https://docs.smallest.ai/.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The job board lists three positions—Senior SDET, Software Engineer–Systems and Reliability, and Manager–Finance and Accounts—none with a qualifying AI/ML title: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/smallest. Although an indexed Speech Research Scientist description remains readable, its live application returns 'Job not found': https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/smallest/0d477f14-bbf8-460c-b015-edd9a376e92c/application.

model_provider.value: Smallest AI’s in-house Lightning text-to-speech models, including Lightning v3.1.
model_provider.notes: The Lightning v3.1 model card explicitly identifies Smallest AI as its developer: https://docs.smallest.ai/models/model-cards/text-to-speech/lightning-v-3-1.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: https://security.smallest.ai/ names all five frameworks, and https://smallest.ai/careers publicly claims SOC 2, GDPR and HIPAA compliance. These are public claims, not confirmation of current independent certification: the trust center marks its displayed SOC 2 report expired in August 2026. | compliance_certs.0: SOC 2 remains publicly claimed; the displayed report is expired, so this is not a claim of current report validity. | compliance_certs.1: The trust center names ISO 27001:2022 and lists ISO certifications as valid until September 2027. | compliance_certs.2: HIPAA is explicitly named in the trust center. | compliance_certs.3: GDPR is explicitly named in the trust center. | compliance_certs.4: The trust center explicitly names PCI DSS and lists a certificate valid until December 2027.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The latest established round is explicitly described as Series A: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/smallestai-gets-21-million-in-funding-to-build-voice-4-0--the-next-generation-of-enterprise-voice-ai-302839266.html. | funding_date: The July 30, 2026 announcement reports the close of the Series A, giving an announced funding month of 2026-07: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/smallestai-gets-21-million-in-funding-to-build-voice-4-0--the-next-generation-of-enterprise-voice-ai-302839266.html. | funding_amount_usd: The funding announcement specifies a $13 million Series A. The $21 million headline refers to cumulative funding, not the round amount: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/smallestai-gets-21-million-in-funding-to-build-voice-4-0--the-next-generation-of-enterprise-voice-ai-302839266.html.

raised_18mo.notes: The $13 million Series A announced July 30, 2026 falls within the requested 18-month window: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/smallestai-gets-21-million-in-funding-to-build-voice-4-0--the-next-generation-of-enterprise-voice-ai-302839266.html.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The three listed openings contain no SDR, BDR or account-executive position: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/smallest. An older BDR application appears in cached content, but its live application now returns 'Job not found': https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/smallest/d5f015ce-7470-4930-9cb3-fc7a930a039b/application.

launched_6mo.notes: The October 5, 2026 Lightning V3 announcement states that the model is available that day, placing a major model launch within the six-month window: https://smallest.ai/blog/introducing-lightning-v3.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: A November 6, 2026 announcement names Siddharth Sharma as President, BFSI India, reporting directly to the CEO. This is treated as a VP-or-higher executive appointment within the 12-month window, although the title is President rather than literally VP or a chief-officer title: https://www.aninews.in/news/business/smallest-ai-names-ex-cred-yes-bank-kotak-digital-banking-leader-siddharth-sharma-president-8211-bfsi-india20261106154941.
